children: Atlas Energy Solutions disclosed two large equipment purchases supporting a dedicated power generation project. The company agreed to buy $340.5 million of balance-of-plant equipment and separately $273.0 million of generation equipment totaling about 328 MW from Wyoming Machinery, with shipments spanning April 2027 to February 2028. The BoP deal includes installment payments, a 10% completion holdback, and a termination-for-convenience option; it is backed by a cost reimbursement agreement with a leading frontier AI lab that is the project offtaker. The generator purchase is subject to tariff pass-throughs from Caterpillar and is expected to satisfy part of Atlas’s obligations under its Global Framework Agreement with Caterpillar, pending confirmation.
